challenges.prompt: Observe the visualization and pick the correct algorithm.
Perform the next correct steps of Insertion Sort on the current array.
Choose the correct function to complete the code and match the target visualization.

visualizationTarget.expectedBehavior: Search space halves each step and returns index if found.

options.functionCode: function MISSING_FN(arr, target){ let l=0,r=arr.length-1; while(l<=r){ const m=Math.floor((l+r)/2); if(arr[m]===target) return m; if(arr[m]<target) l=m+1; else r=m-1;} return -1; }
function MISSING_FN(arr, target){ for(let i=0;i<arr.length;i++){ if(arr[i]===target) return i; } return -1; }

function MISSING_FN(arr, target){ const n=arr.length; const step=Math.floor(Math.sqrt(n)); let prev=0; while(arr[Math.min(step,n)-1] < target){ prev=step; if(prev>=n) return -1; } for(let i=prev;i<Math.min(step,n);i++){ if(arr[i]===target) return i; } return -1; }

function MISSING_FN(arr, target){ let lo=0, hi=arr.length-1; while(lo<=hi && target>=arr[lo] && target<=arr[hi]){ if(lo===hi) return arr[lo]===target?lo:-1; const pos=lo + Math.floor(((target-arr[lo])*(hi-lo))/(arr[hi]-arr[lo])); if(arr[pos]===target) return pos; if(arr[pos]<target) lo=pos+1; else hi=pos-1; } return -1; }

challenges.prompt: Pick the correct function from 4 options. Labels can be misleading.

visualizationTarget.expectedBehavior: Recursively split and merge sorted halves.

options.functionCode: function MISSING_FN(arr){ if(arr.length<=1) return arr; const mid=Math.floor(arr.length/2); const left=MISSING_FN(arr.slice(0,mid)); const right=MISSING_FN(arr.slice(mid)); const out=[]; let i=0,j=0; while(i<left.length&&j<right.length){ out.push(left[i]<=right[j]?left[i++]:right[j++]); } return out.concat(left.slice(i)).concat(right.slice(j)); }

function MISSING_FN(arr){ if(arr.length<=1) return arr; const p=arr[arr.length-1]; const l=[],r=[]; for(let i=0;i<arr.length-1;i++){ if(arr[i]<p) l.push(arr[i]); else r.push(arr[i]); } return [...MISSING_FN(l),p,...MISSING_FN(r)]; }
function MISSING_FN(arr){ const a=[...arr]; a.sort((x,y)=>x-y); return a; }

function MISSING_FN(arr){ if(arr.length===0) return []; const max=Math.max(...arr); const cnt=new Array(max+1).fill(0); for(const x of arr) cnt[x]++; const out=[]; for(let i=0;i<cnt.length;i++){ while(cnt[i]-->0) out.push(i); } return out; }
